what: On open the header panel lights in .5s and the letters of the big title words light in random order within .5s. At 1.25s the title line, spread to both ends (justify-content: space-between), widens from 86% to 100% width in .8s circ.out, and at the same time the header panel that filled 90vh of the screen folds to its own height. At 1.75s the subtitle letters light randomly, .41s each — an agency Hero where three words are pushed to both screen edges and the first Work rises up

options.[data-fx-part=title]: Heading line to spread — the words inside are spaced out with space-between
options.[data-fx-part=sub]: (If any) Subtitle that lights up late at random
options.delay: Time when it starts to split open (s), default 1.25
options.amount: Total length (sec) over which the random character order is scattered, default .5
options.height: Initial hero panel height, default 90vh — none means no collapse
options.min: Below this width (px) it does not move, default 768 (the original turns it off on phones and small tablets)

note: The original is a Webflow IX3 load timeline (letters random opacity · 1.25s width 86→100% · 1.27s head panel height 90vh→auto · 1.75s subtitle)
